messages:
liz: Kicking off the Husky joint HW perf run — goal is perf/W sweep + throughput curves + kernel tuning checks across small/medium/large batch shapes. Dry-run next Tue, full run Thu. Need telemetry handoff, power telemetry, and comms plan. @sung-min (Husky) can you confirm SSH access + metrics endpoint? Also need IPMI/power sensor access.

sung-min (Husky): We can provide SSH + metrics URL. IPMI creds will be sent via DM to ops. Tue dry-run looks good on our side. Will also expose per-GPU power sensors. :+1:

pranav: I'll own the test matrix and runner. Proposed runner command snippet:```bash
./run_swarm.sh --model=llama-13b --quant=4bit --seq=2048 --batch=[1,4,8,16] --profile=perf_w
```

I'll instrument with `perf_probe` and our existing perf collector. Need the exact kernel build id and CUDA so results are reproducible.

marc: Kernel build for Husky nodes is `rdoe-6.1.32-redwood3`, CUDA `12.2`. Uploading kernel config to the workspace shortly.

julia: Telemetry schema (prometheus-friendly): we need labels `host`, `gpu_id`, `run_id`, `model`, `batch`. Metrics to capture: `power_w`, `tokens_per_sec`, `latency_p50_ms`, `latency_p95_ms`, `gpu_mem_mb`, `kv_cache_miss_rate`. Power scrape at 5s preferred, fallback 10s. Sample JSON for the telemetry handoff:```json
{
  "labels": ["host","gpu_id","run_id","model","batch"],
  "metrics": ["power_w","tokens_per_sec","latency_p50_ms","latency_p95_ms","gpu_mem_mb","kv_cache_miss_rate"],
  "scrape_interval_s": 5
}
```
Please confirm export path for the metrics and whether Husky will push or we should pull.

bench-bot: job 4578 created — dry-run queued on `husky-swarm-3`. ETA ~45m. Logs will stream to https://ci.redwood/tests/4578 :rocket:

kate: Heads-up on comms: we want a joint blog + marketplace blurb post-run. Draft due Fri. Who can provide a quick quote and logo? @sung-min and @liz? Also need legal review lead time (~2 working days).

sung-min (Husky): I'll provide a short quote and vector logo by Wed. Legal has been looped in on Husky side, they asked for sample wording.

nathan: Ops note — please lock thermal and power caps for repeatability: set `FAN_TARGET=70` and `POWER_CAP=300W` per GPU for the runs. Watch for any thermal throttling events in the first 10 minutes.

liz: Nice. Action items we're tracking: 1) Pranav — finalize runner + matrix, 2) Julia — telemetry schema + alert thresholds, 3) Marc — kernel config + build artifact, 4) Kate — comm draft + legal path, 5) Sung-min — IPMI creds + metrics endpoint + logo/quote. React with :thumbsup: when done.

bench-bot: dry-run job 4578 started on husky-swarm-3 (log stream: https://ci.redwood/tests/4578/logs). Current status: warmup -> collecting baseline.

pranav: Quick note — we'll include a lightweight KV-cache miss tracer to understand cross-run variance. Adds ~1% overhead but worth it.

marc: Uploaded kernel config and build artifact: gs://redwood-artifacts/husky/kernels/rdoe-6.1.32-redwood3/config.txt.

julia: Confirmed: Husky will push metrics to our pull endpoint at https://metrics.redwood/ingest/husky-swarm. Sending alert thresholds in 1h.

kate: Draft for blog created (internal link) — please review for technical accuracy. Need final quotes by Thu EOD.

liz: Great progress. I'll check back after dry-run completes and we'll decide whether to expand to 32-batch legs for full-run. Thanks everyone.
